Generate a codebook for a survey dataset

Source: R/codebook.R
sd_codebook.Rd

The automated version of "06_generoi_codebook.R": prepares the data with sd_prepare_codebook_data() (labels, value labels, automatic Likert scale-mean columns), writes a minimal R Markdown document that calls codebook::codebook() on it, and renders that document to a self-contained HTML file with rmarkdown::render().

Usage

sd_codebook(
  x,
  out_dir = "inst/codebook",
  file_name = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  min_items = 2,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

An sd_data object.

out_dir

Directory to save the codebook HTML to. Default "inst/codebook", matching where a codebook is conventionally kept in a package.

file_name

File name for the saved codebook. Defaults to "codebook.html". A .html extension is added if missing.

groups, min_items

Passed on to sd_prepare_codebook_data().

overwrite

If FALSE (the default) and the target file already exists, sd_codebook() refuses to overwrite it and raises an error instead — set TRUE once you've checked the existing file.

Value

An object of class sd_codebook with elements data (the prepared data frame passed into the codebook), groups (detected/used scale groups), file (the rendered HTML's path), and created.

Why via R Markdown

codebook::codebook() is designed to run inside a knitted R Markdown document — called directly at the console (as the original script did) it returns a knit_asis object (confirmed by testing against a real installation), which is only meaningful once actually knitted: it isn't a complete, standalone HTML page on its own; plots and interactive tables are only fully assembled during a real rmarkdown::render() pass. So instead of guessing at that object, sd_codebook() builds a tiny .Rmd behind the scenes and renders it properly, which is the standard supported way to automate codebook outside of RStudio's interactive Viewer/Ctrl+S workflow.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
aineisto <- sd_read("survey_data.sav")
aineisto <- sd_detect_roles(aineisto)
tulos <- sd_codebook(aineisto)
tulos$file
} # }
